purpose: Performance and context compression layer for Agent Lee and the Leeway sovereign runtime.
build_order: v0.4 Code Mode and research-lane compression
v0.5 dashboard metrics and savings receipts
doctrine: Compress what the LLM reads, not what Leeway stores. Receipts and source artifacts remain complete.
source_pattern: Headroom-style local-first compression, proxy, MCP, cross-agent memory, reversible retrieval, output shaping, and learning from failed sessions.

integration_points.code_mode: Compress file search, terminal logs, patch diffs, and test output before model reasoning.
integration_points.research_lane: Compress deep search results and research briefs before synthesis.
integration_points.leeway_api_gateway: Compress large request/response payloads before routing to LLM-backed lanes.
integration_points.telegram_shell: Compress long responses for brain context while still sending full artifacts as files.
integration_points.open_notebook: Compress notebook sources, PDFs, and extracted content before chat.
integration_points.runtime_fabric: Compress service health dumps, Docker logs, registry output, and long tool results.
integration_points.seafile_gateway: Store originals and receipts; context gateway stores compact indexes and retrieval pointers.
